title: Who Am I? Animal Guessing Game for Kids with Milo
description:
Who am I? Play the animal guessing game with Milo the bluebird! Listen to three clues, guess the animal, then see why each fact is true: zebra stripes keep flies away, pigs roll in mud to keep cool, a koala is not a bear, and polar bears paddle with paws as big as dinner plates.
An interactive animal guessing game for kids ages 2-6, with questions to answer, actions to copy and a quiz at the end.
facts: A zebra's stripes make it hard for biting flies to land: horses in striped coats got far fewer fly landings (Caro et al., University of Bristol / UC Davis, PLOS ONE 2019).
Pigs have very few working sweat glands, so they wallow in mud to cool down; mud also protects their skin from sunburn (Bracke 2011, Applied Animal Behaviour Science).
A koala is a marsupial, not a bear; its baby is called a joey and grows in the mother's pouch (San Diego Zoo; Australian Koala Foundation).
Polar bears are strong swimmers; their front paws work like paddles and are as big as dinner plates (Polar Bears International).

segments.name: hello
lines: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are going to play a guessing game!
Four animal friends are hiding.
I will give you three clues. Then you guess who it is.
Put on your thinking cap. Are you ready? Let's play!

segments.name: zebra
lines: Guess who! Here are three clues.
Clue one. This friend looks like a horse.
Clue two. This friend has black and white stripes.

lines.t: Clue three. This friend lives on the sunny, grassy savanna. Who is it?

lines: It is the zebra! Great guessing!
close:zebra
Now, here is the fun fact. A zebra's stripes help keep the pesky flies away!
Look. The flies land on the plain brown horse.
exhibit
But on the stripy zebra? The stripes mix the flies up. They cannot land!
exhibit
Say it with me. Stripes keep the flies away!
close:host
Can you gallop like a zebra? Clip, clop, clip, clop!
What a great gallop!

short.title: Zebra Stripes Keep Flies Away! Guess the Animal

segments.name: pig
lines: Guess who! Here are three clues.
Clue one. This friend is pink, with a curly tail.
Clue two. This friend lives on the farm.

lines.t: Clue three. This friend says oink, oink! Who is it?

lines: It is the pig! You got it!
close:pig
What does a pig do on a hot, sunny day? Here is the fun fact.
Pigs roll in the mud to keep cool!
exhibit
When you are hot, you sweat. But a pig cannot sweat much.
So the pig rolls in cool, squishy mud. The mud even stops sunburn, like sunscreen!
exhibit
Say it with me. Pigs roll in mud to keep cool!
close:host
Can you roll your arms like a pig in the mud? Roll, roll, roll!
Super rolling!

short.title: Why Do Pigs Roll in Mud? To Keep Cool!

segments.name: koala
lines: Guess who! Here are three clues.
Clue one. This friend is gray and fluffy, with a big black nose.
Clue two. This friend loves to hug a tree.

lines.t: Clue three. This friend munches on green leaves. Who is it?

lines: It is the koala! Well done!
close:koala

lines.t: Now, a tricky question. Is a koala a bear?

lines: No! Here is the fun fact. A koala is not a bear!
Look. This is a bear. A bear has no pouch.
exhibit
But a mama koala has a pouch on her tummy, like a cozy pocket. Her baby rides inside!
teach
A baby koala is called a joey.
close:koala
Say it with me. A koala is not a bear!
close:host
Can you hug yourself, like a koala hugs a tree? Squeeze!
What a lovely hug!

short.title: A Koala Is Not a Bear! Guess the Animal

segments.name: polar_bear
lines: Guess who! Here are three clues.
Clue one. This friend is very big and very fluffy.
Clue two. This friend lives where it is icy and cold.

lines.t: Clue three. This friend looks as white as snow. Who is it?

lines: It is the polar bear! Hooray!
close:polar_bear
Yes! Here is the fun fact. Polar bears are super swimmers!
Look at those big front paws. They work like paddles in the water.
exhibit
Each paw is as big as a dinner plate!
exhibit
Say it with me. Polar bears are super swimmers!
close:host
Can you paddle your paws like a polar bear? Paddle, paddle, paddle!
Splendid swimming!

short.title: Polar Bear Paws Are as Big as Dinner Plates!

segments.name: quiz
lines: Wow! You guessed all four friends. Now it is quiz time!
Get ready. Think hard!
quiz: Whose stripes keep the flies away?
Who rolls in the mud to keep cool?
Who is not a bear, and rides in a pouch as a baby?
Whose paws are as big as dinner plates?

segments.name: goodbye
lines: You learned four new things today.
Gallop like a zebra. Roll like a pig. Hug like a koala. And paddle like a polar bear!
Which friend was the hardest to guess?
Thank you for playing with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
